# origincloud_network_route (Resource)

A route: traffic to `destination` leaves through one gateway. Set exactly one of `internet_gateway` and `nat_gateway`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) The destination: the IPv4 default route, written with an all-zero address and prefix length 0, or the IPv6 one, `::/0`. A route table decides only where traffic to the internet goes. Changing it replaces the route.
- `project` (String) The project the route is in. Changing it replaces the route.
- `region` (String) The region the route is in. Changing it replaces the route.
- `route_table` (String) The route table the route is in. Changing it replaces the route.

### Optional

- `internet_gateway` (String) The internet gateway of the table's VPC to send the traffic to. Changing it replaces the route.
- `nat_gateway` (String) The NAT gateway in the table's VPC to send the traffic to, for the IPv4 default route only: a NAT gateway translates IPv4 only. Named in the gateway's own zone; a name with another zone is refused with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. Changing it replaces the route.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The route's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The route's resource name.
